_comment: Named starting points for procedural_face geometry. An archetype is a COMPLETE geometry block: create_persona names one and adjusts a few values from it, which keeps a small model from inventing a dozen numbers cold. Every value is normalised against the head's own bounding box. The face is eyes-first: two vertical capsules carry the character (no brows; the mouth only appears during speech or a transient). eye_size is the capsule's half-width as a fraction of the head's half-width; eye_length is its height as a multiple of its width; eye_tilt is a resting parallel lean in radians. The expression library applies relative deltas to whichever geometry a persona ends up with, so archetypes carry appearance only, never motion. Design: tasks/persona-avatar-system.md.

warm_round._comment: Soft and approachable: a round head, two tall friendly capsules, a warm smile when it speaks. The Sulivan-adjacent default.

narrow_precise._comment: Composed and exact: a taller, narrower head, long thin capsules with a subtle italic lean, a level mouth. Selene-adjacent.

wide_open._comment: Eager and expressive: a wide head, stubbier rounder capsules set far apart, a broad upturned mouth when speaking. Reads younger and louder.
